name: tillertouch
description: A second look at every tool call and every reply, always or only when you write TT. Sends one back once when it skips a clearly better way, names a gap without a way to close it, or asks for approval without showing what to approve. Reminds each prompt to look for a better tool first.

mode.title: When the second look runs
mode.description: demand checks the tool calls and the reply only in a turn whose prompt contains TT. permanent checks every call and every reply.

model.title: Model for the second look
model.description: The model that judges the calls and the reply, for example opus, sonnet or haiku. A smaller one is faster and cheaper but misses more.

prompt_nudge.title: Look for a better route on every prompt
prompt_nudge.description: Adds a short note to each prompt asking for a better method, tool, skill or existing helper before the obvious route.

prompt_nudge_text.title: Wording of the prompt note
prompt_nudge_text.description: Replaces the default note. Leave empty to keep the default.
